description: `ref="name"` attribute that gives script code access to a DOM element or component instance after mount.
Vue 3.5 API: `useTemplateRef<T>('name')` returns a shallow ref linked to `ref="name"` in the template.
Macro that declares the public instance API of a `<script setup>` component.
`<script setup>` components expose nothing through refs unless they call `defineExpose`.
